description: This file defines the 'Transaction' entity class within the payment module, modeling payment transactions including fields like amount, date, type, payment method, details, and related order information. It implements serialization, auditing, and JSON conversion functionalities.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a payment transaction, including fields like amount, date, transaction type, payment type, associated order, and detailed info, along with auditing and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section of the transaction for auditing purposes.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for this transaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Gets the associated order for this transaction.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an order with this transaction.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date and time of the transaction.

methods.name: setTransactionDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Gets the type of transaction (e.g., payment, refund).

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Retrieves the details of the transaction in string form.

methods.name: getTransactionDetails
methods.description: Returns the map of transaction details.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the transaction details map into a JSON string.
